title: Fever Dream
text:
“Fever Dream” explores transformation, memory, and desire, a hallucination caught between sleep and wakefulness. The editorial unfolds in fragments, like a dream that can’t be named but lingers.

Layered textures and sculptural forms create a space where instinct overrules thought. Materials cling, melt, resist, reacting like skin, alive.

Light enters not as illumination, but feeling, bruising, glowing, shifting meaning. What’s hidden holds as much weight as what’s revealed. Perception drifts, untethered.
